name: A Frightened Request
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database. Its experience counts the level 30 build, which halved what dungeon quests give beyond a normal quest.

narrative.details:
It's my husband Edward...

He has not returned from his weekly journey to the graveyard in the Lordaeron ruins. Our son was lost when Arthas razed the city, and my dear Edward is still filled with guilt and sorrow that we never found his body. I've tried to warn him against searching those overrun ruins, but he refuses to give up. I try not worry, but it's been days.

There are things there I cannot contend with but if you are willing, I need to know the fate of my husband.
narrative.objectives: Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
narrative.offerRewardText: What I asked of you was not fair, nor would it have been unjust for you to simply walk away. Thank you stranger. I am unable to repay you in kind but I hope one of these is acceptable.I hope our paths cross again without such sorrow.
